channel.title: Sankaku Complex — AniNews Hub RSS
channel.description: Latest stories from Sankaku Complex through AniNews Hub.

item.title: Xbox Allegedly Blocked Anime Games Because One Employee Disliked Them
item.description: Xbox may have rejected certain anime-style games because a single person within Microsoft’s gaming division personally disliked them, according to an unverified industry rumor shared by Windows Central journalist Jez Corden.

item.title: Malfoid Meme Spawns Another AI-Generated Anime Parody
item.description: Harry Potter’s Malfoid meme has yet to disappear and fade into obscurity as most memes eventually do, as yet more creators are making use of AI to create anime-style parodies of Harry Potter where Draco Malfoy (and other characters) is instead a tsundere woman.

item.title: Robots That Stock Shelves & Speak 20 Languages Could Arrive in Japan in 2027
item.description: Japanese convenience stores could begin employing humanoid robots as early as 2027, with new AI-powered machines capable of stocking shelves, managing inventory, bagging purchases and assisting customers in more than 20 languages.

item.title: New Girls und Panzer Game Announced Featuring 10-Player Online Tank Battles
item.description: D3 Publisher has announced Girls und Panzer: All-Star Tank Carnival, a new action game based on the popular anime series, scheduled for release exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

item.title: Court Rules Sanrio Didn’t Create Kuromi, but Dismisses Copyright Lawsuit Against Company
item.description: A Japanese court has ruled that Sanrio was not the original creator of Kuromi, officially recognizing animation studio Studio Comet as the character’s creator. However, despite this acknowledgment, the court dismissed the studio’s copyright infringement lawsuit against Sanrio.

item.title: Danganronpa Creator Says Growing Studio Would Force Him to Make Games He Doesn’t Want to Make
item.description: Danganronpa creator and The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy director Kazutaka Kodaka has explained why he intends to keep his development studio small, arguing that expanding would force his team to accept projects they have no interest in making simply to stay financially afloat.

item.title: Gundam SEED Director Reveals New Movie Uses His Late Wife’s Final Screenplay
item.description: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO director Mitsuo Fukuda has revealed that the upcoming anime film brings to life the final screenplay completed by his late wife, Chiaki Morosawa, who passed away in 2016.

item.title: Shibuya Cracks Down on Halloween With Fines, Alcohol Restrictions & Massive Security Presence
item.description: Tokyo’s Shibuya district is preparing for a major Halloween crackdown, announcing 74 million yen (approximately $468,000) in security and crowd-control measures to prevent the chaotic street celebrations that have plagued the area in previous years.

item.title: Japan Hit by Wave of Cyberattacks, Exposing 10 Million+ Personal Records & Disrupting Food Supplies
item.description: Japan is facing a wave of major cyberattacks that have disrupted businesses, government websites and food distribution networks, while exposing or potentially compromising more than 10 million personal information records.

item.title: Blue Archive’s Satsuki Definitely Distracting in Figure Form
item.description: Another adorable anime girl is becoming an item that will ensure that creators a fortune as this figurine of Blue Archive’s Satsuki is quite the piece of work, the woman’s significant cleavage bound to keep males distracted from whatever it is she is meant to be doing.

item.title: Overlord Manga Goes on Indefinite Hiatus as Artist Announces Hospitalization
item.description: The manga adaptation of Overlord: New World Arc is going on an indefinite hiatus after its artist, Matsuki, announced that they will be hospitalized and require further medical treatment and rest.

item.title: Fortnite Player Arrested by FBI After Threatening to Shoot FBI Agents in Voice Chat
item.description: A 29-year-old Fortnite player from Alabama was arrested by the FBI after allegedly threatening to shoot federal agents during an in-game voice chat, only for those same agents to show up at his home days later.

item.title: Senran Kagura: Shinobi Nexus Brings Out Some Sexy New Ninja Girls
item.description: Honey Parade Games has released a new trailer for Shinobi Nexus: Senran Kagura, introducing the franchise’s cast of ninja girls and giving hardcore fans their first look at the newest Senran Kagura in quite some time.

item.title: NieR Fans Mock 2B’s Blindfold-Less Appearance in Dead by Daylight Collaboration
item.description: NieR fans are criticizing 2B’s appearance in Dead by Daylight after images showing the character without her iconic blindfold circulated online, with some arguing that her face looks nothing like the original character, while the model in general looks way too masculine.

item.title: Skullgirls Artists Accuse Developers of Unfairly Removing Their Fan Art Contest Entries
item.description: The developers of Skullgirls are facing criticism after two artists accused them of quietly removing their submissions from the game’s 2026 Halloween fan art contest, despite their artwork initially being selected.

item.title: Sony Launches New Crunchyroll Division to Turn Anime Into Live-Action & Global Stories Into Anime
item.description: Sony has announced the creation of Crunchyroll Storyworks, a new division dedicated to developing live-action adaptations of Japanese anime while also bringing stories from around the world into anime.

item.title: Harry Potter Malfoid Meme Now Inspiring AI-Generated Anime Adaptations
item.description: The Harry Potter “Malfoid” meme character has continued to accrue renown on social media as she has now not only inspired artists to produce art of the tsundere genderswap, but now there are anime-styled AI animations.

item.title: Publishers Furious After Major Distributor Admits Selling Books to AI Company Anthropic
item.description: Japanese publishers are expressing outrage after one of the country’s largest book distributors acknowledged selling large quantities of Japanese books to Anthropic, the American AI company behind Claude, raising concerns that the publications may have been destroyed and digitized for AI training…

item.title: Netflix’s Yani Neko Subtitles Remove Japanese Christian History Reference
item.description: The English Netflix subtitles for Yani Neko have come under scrutiny over a translation that removes a specific reference to Japanese Christian history, replacing it with a more general statement about religious persecution.

item.title: Yoko Taro Achieved Game Development Dreams With Drakengard, Works to “Prevent Dementia”
item.description: NieR creator Yoko Taro says he already accomplished everything he dreamed of doing in game development with the original Drakengard, and these days one of the things keeping him working is an unusual concern: preventing dementia.

item.title: Former Capcom Dev Says “Extreme Crunch” Kept Women Out of Director Roles in Japan
item.description: Former Capcom developer Masakazu Sugimori believes Japan’s historically extreme crunch culture may help explain why relatively few women rose to become prominent game directors (save for the more obvious reason), arguing that the industry’s old working conditions disproportionately favored people…

item.title: Japan Asks Public Which Laws & Regulations Are Getting in the Way of AI
item.description: The Japanese government is asking people and businesses working with AI to tell it which of the country’s existing laws and regulations are preventing them from actually using the technology.

item.title: Sega’s Official Sonic Discord Descends Into Chaos Hours After Launch
item.description: The Western Sonic “fanbase” has once again demonstrated the extent to which they are socially incapable as Sega’s attempt to give Sonic the Hedgehog fans a new official gathering place descended into chaos within hours.

item.title: Japanese Game Developer Says $1.26 Million in Unpaid Fees Forced It to Lay Off 70 Employees
item.description: A Japanese game developer says nearly ¥200 million ($1.26 million) in unpaid development fees pushed the company into financial ruin, ultimately forcing it to lay off 70 full-time employees.
